progress_reporting.when: After each implemented screen, before switching workspace or handoff. Propose only tested items; identify the build and limitations. Do not duplicate unchanged pending/accepted work. Human approval still required.

delivery_gate.rule:
A screen or workspace is unfinished until its working UI, F1 contextual help, English/Urdu screen handbook,
workspace guide and detailed FAQ for every supported role, bounded 100-250% keyboard zoom, frontend coverage checks,
and named human review of fresh, newly created data and supported CRUD operations are complete. Follow the workspace review
checklist (guide 17). Missing evidence stays pending; seeded-demo browsing, API tests or screenshots alone do not
establish completion. Agents propose evidence; only authenticated human review accepts progress.

compulsory.label: F1 contextual help
compulsory.what: F1 opens the correct permitted help, including from fields/dialogs, preserves unsaved work and restores focus. Visible Help also works; login/locked/kiosk help exposes only public/operator guidance.

compulsory.label: Complete role-specific FAQs
compulsory.what: Every supported role task in this workspace, including shared screens and handovers, has a detailed reviewed English/Urdu FAQ. Follow get_handbook_outline; a generic FAQ or an unreviewed role journey is unfinished.

compulsory.label: Keyboard zoom: 100-250% only
compulsory.what: Ctrl++/Ctrl+=, Ctrl+- and Ctrl+0 (Command on macOS), Settings and all enabled zoom routes share one state clamped to 100-250%. Test both bounds, reset, persistence and usable English/Urdu layouts at 250%.

compulsory.label: Human review with newly created data
compulsory.what: A named human follows guide 17 on this build: creates new synthetic records through the UI and verifies read, update/correction and permitted delete/cancel/deactivate paths, refusal paths and handovers. Read-only screens use fresh upstream records. Record IDs and evidence; pre-existing demo data alone is insufficient.

zoom.one_state: The keys, the Settings slider and any menu, wheel or pinch zoom move ONE zoom state, clamped to 100.0-250.0 %, saved as ui_scale_pct (PUT /settings/me) and restored at login (/auth/me preferences). Electron: webContents.setZoomFactor(pct / 100).

delivery_gate.workspace_done_when: Every screen of the workspace has every compulsory item above, in addition to its endpoints, events and rules: F1 contextual Help, a detailed FAQ for every role of the workspace (English and Urdu), the bounded keyboard zoom and a named human's review with newly created data (get_guide('workspace-review-checklist')), signed on the portal. Missing any one, the workspace is NOT done: report it as pending, never as complete.

acceptance_rules: Show accession_number prominently — the modality must use it so studies auto-link.
Worklist: emergencies first, then due_at (is_overdue red); show laterality, transport, escort and pregnancy_check_needed.

Start (status InProgress) = the checks before the examination (MSDS AAC 10, 13): scan the wristband (wristband_code) or TwoIdentifiers, tick site_confirmed after checking the site and side against the order, and when pregnancy_check_needed ask and send pregnancy_status (Pregnant: pregnancy_note with the decision). Missing: PATIENT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED / IMAGING_SAFETY_CHECK_REQUIRED.
Complete: with contrast, send contrast (agent, dose, route) and contrast_doctor_id (the PMDC doctor present). A study linked while the examination is in progress completes it.

Report (radiologists only: IMAGING_REPORTER_NOT_AUTHORIZED otherwise): pick a critical finding from GET /critical-imaging-findings (critical_finding_id) and/or describe it (critical_finding_note): the critical results log opens and the doctor is alerted; phone them now and record it (screen critical_results_radiology).
A report is final once entered and carries the reporter's stamp; print it for the patient (report/print-payload).

Exists for the service imaging (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id radiology_worklist (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.

endpoints.description:
`InProgress` records the checks before the examination (MSDS AAC 10, 13): the patient identified (`wristband_code`
scanned, or `identity_check` TwoIdentifiers; `EmergencyOverride` with a note for an emergency patient), the site and
side confirmed (`site_confirmed`), and for a woman of child-bearing age before ionising radiation the
`pregnancy_status` (Pregnant: `pregnancy_note`). Missing: `PATIENT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED` or
`IMAGING_SAFETY_CHECK_REQUIRED`. `Completed` with `contrast` names the doctor present (`contrast_doctor_id`, PMDC).
Moves the state machine allows only (`IMAGING_ORDER_STATE_INVALID`); `Cancelled` needs a reason.
`PATIENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH`: the wristband scanned is not this patient's: stop and check who the patient is.

**Required permission:** `imaging.order.update`

backend_reports.title: Radiographer cannot look up the clinical doctor ID required to record contrast safely
backend_reports.actual: The status contract requires contrast_doctor_id, but the screen bundle has no doctor lookup. GET /staff/lookup returns employee_id/emp_number/name/designation/department only. GET /ot/privileges is unavailable to radiographers/radiologists by its own access list and is not a doctor directory. Finance service catalogue exposes doctor_id only for catalogued services and has no PMDC registration, not a complete clinical doctor picker. Searches doctor/doctors/physician/consultant/clinical privileges did not identify a suitable permitted lookup. Frontend can accept an actual known hospital-confirmed ID but cannot offer a reliable complete selection or convert staff IDs.
backend_reports.expected: Provide a permitted read-only picker/lookup of actual doctors (clinical doctor_id, display name, PMDC registration/eligibility) to imaging.order.update users, or document an existing suitable endpoint in radiology_worklist's bundle. Completed with contrast requires contrast_doctor_id naming the PMDC doctor physically present (MSDS AAC10/13). Never infer clinical doctor_id from employee_id.
